name: Flight 6
summary: Booster 13's catch was aborted when a tower health check failed, after equipment on the tower was damaged at liftoff, so the booster diverted to a soft splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico. Ship 31 performed the first in-space relight of a single Raptor engine and tested a steeper reentry and new thermal protection materials. It made the first daylight splashdown of a Starship in the Indian Ocean about 65 minutes after launch. A toy banana rode along as a zero-g indicator, Starship's first payload.
highlights: Booster catch called off; booster diverted to a Gulf splashdown
First Starship with a positive perigee
Toy banana flown as a zero-g indicator
Last flight of a Block 1 ship

boosterFate: Catch aborted; diverted to a soft splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico at T+6:51, about 32 km downrange, and broke up afterwards.
shipFate: Controlled daylight splashdown in the Indian Ocean at T+1:05:24.
